title: Amplified finite machine
statement: Given a finite nondeterministic Turing machine $N$ over Boolean symbols, a natural number $r$, and a function $\mathrm{dec} : \mathbb{N} \to \{\mathrm{false},\mathrm{true}\}$, define a finite nondeterministic Turing machine with $(r+1)k$ work tapes, where $k$ is the number of work tapes of $N$, and state space $\mathrm{Phase}(\mathrm{State}(N),r)$. Its initial state is the run phase indexed by $0$, initialized with the initial state of $N$ and the additional values `none` and $0$; its transitions are those specified by the amplification construction from $N$, $r$, and $\mathrm{dec}$.

Boolean-valued function $\mathrm{dec}$ on the natural numbers
